questions.prompt: Nta gihoraho mw isi.  Ibyo dukwiriye kutabyibagirwa.
questions.answer: Nothing lasts on (this) world.  We must not forget that.

questions.prompt: Mbese ntiwibuka wa mwungeri twabonye ejo?  Yee, ngaho rero mbwira ibye.
questions.answer: Don't you remember that shepherd we saw yesterday?  Yes.  Very well then, tell me about him.

questions.prompt: Iryo sezerano rizadukomeza iteka -- mu bihe byo kunguka no mu byo gukena
questions.answer: That promise will sustain us forever -- in times of increase and in those of poverty.

questions.prompt: Hari ikindi dukwiriye kutibagirwa: ni bya bihe by'ubukene, kuko bitwibutsa yuko abo mu muryango wa Petero badufashije mu buryo butangaje.
questions.answer: There is something else we must not forget -- it is those times of poverty, because they remind us that Peter's family helped us in a marvelous way.

questions.prompt: Urugendo tuzarutangira ejo.  Ibyo bikwiriye gutuma twitegura none.
questions.answer: We will begin the journey tomorrow.  That should cause us to prepare today.

questions.prompt: Yagiye kubaka rwa rusika rw'inzu ye.  Mbese ntiwibuka ukuntu rwaguye?
questions.answer: He went to build that wall.  Don't you remember how it fell?

questions.prompt: Bakunda gusoma amagambo yanditse.  Ayo mvuga n'ayo yanditse mu bitabo yabahaye atarapfa.
questions.answer: They love to read the words he wrote.  Those (the words) I'm speaking about are those he wrote in the books he gave them before he died.

questions.prompt: Isahane irimwo ubusa gusa.  Ntiharimo uburo, haba na rumwe.
questions.answer: There is absolutely nothing in the dish.  There is not a grain of millet in it, no, not one.

questions.prompt: Ibyo mvuga n'iby'inzara yateye mu gihugu.  Mbese ntiwibuka wa mwaka war'umeze utyo?
questions.answer: What I'm speaking about is the famine which ravaged the country.  Don't you remember the year when it was like that?

questions.prompt: Bose barakena cyane.  Ibyo s'igitangaza, kuko nta mvura na nke babonye.
questions.answer: They are all very poor. This isn't surprising, because they have not had any rain at all.

questions.prompt: Ibyo twamuhaye yabiriye byose.  Dukwiriye kumuha ibindi, kuko nta cyo afite rwose.
questions.answer: She ate everything we gave her.  We should give her more, because she has absolutely nothing.

questions.prompt: Dukwiriye kwitegura ya ngobyi kuko arwaye cyane.
questions.answer: We must prepare that stretcher because he is very sick.

questions.prompt: Isezerano s'ubusa; dukwiriye kurikomeza.  Mbese ibyo nawe ntubyemera?
questions.answer: A promise is not worthless; we must keep it.  Don't you also agree?

questions.prompt: Hari ikindi nkwiriye kukwibutsa: Ni twegera Imana, na yo izatwegera.  Mbese iryo sezerano ntuyizera?
questions.answer: There's also something else I should remind you: if we draw near to God, He will draw near to us also.  Don't you believe that promise?

questions.prompt: Mukobwa wanjye nkunda, sinzongera kubikubwira.  Ibyo ukwiriye kubyibuka n'ujya gukina.
questions.answer: My dear daughter, I will not tell you again.  You must remember that when you go to play.

questions.prompt: Ntimukwiriye gupfa kwemera ibyo uwo mugabo avuga byose.
questions.answer: You should not simply agree to everything that man says.

questions.prompt: Banze kwica za ntama, nubwo nabahaye uburyo.
questions.answer: They refused to kill those sheep, even though I provided them with a way.

questions.prompt: Ni twubaka neza, inzu izahagarara iminsi myinshi.  Ibyo, mbese ntubyemera?
questions.answer: If we build well, the house will stand for many days.  Don't you agree with that?

questions.prompt: Wa mugabo, narabimuhaye.  Na we azabyemera n'umubaza
questions.answer: That man -- I gave them to him.  He also will agree to it/admit it if you ask him.

questions.prompt: Abo bantu bankijije akaga kenshi; nanjye nkwiriye kubibuka muri ibi bihe bibi.
questions.answer: Those people saved me from danger often; and I must remember them in these bad times.

questions.prompt: Sinigeze gukora ibimeze bityo; haba na rimwe.
questions.answer: I never ever did something like that; not even once.
